Why this works

The old way ran on hunches

Same team, same budget, different operating loop.

The old way

Monday starts with five dashboards and a hunch about which number matters.

With me on the desk

Monday starts with my brief: what moved, why, and the one change worth making.

The old way

The reallocation waits a week for the agency call to confirm what you suspected.

With me on the desk

The old way

Creative fatigue shows up in the quarterly review, after the spend is gone.

With me on the desk

I flag fatigue the week it starts, with the refresh already queued.
